messages:
jon_support: Heads up — ACME Corp onboarding is blocked, seeing provisioning 503s then repeated 429s. Customer has a demo call at 15:00 PST and flagged renewal risk if not live by EOW. /cc @sara_cs @linda_am

sara_cs: Acknowledged. Can you paste the latest logs and exact repro steps? Any temporary workaround we can offer for the demo?

jon_support: Logs snippet:
```
POST /v1/provision -> 503 { \"error\": \"backend_queue_full\" }
then repeated 429 rate_limited for tenant_id=acme-22
```
We escalated to eng but they want a traffic sample and pool status.

mike_eng: Looking now. Early signal: dedicated pool quota hit, autoscaler didn't spin due to a config flag mismatch (scale_policy name). I'm running remediation. ETA ~45m.

linda_am: Got it. I need a comms plan for the 15:00 call — they want clarity on timeline and a fallback. Proposed plan: be transparent, share ETA 45m, offer a preview (read-only) for the demo, promise full provisioning update by 17:00. Agree?

sara_cs: +1 to the plan. I'll lead the call. mike, can we expose a provisioning_preview so they can at least walk through the UI (no writes)?

mike_eng: Yes — can flip a preview flag for acme-22 (read-only) in ~20m. Will post command when done.

jon_support: Running the flag now:
```
/feature-flag enable acme-22 provisioning_preview=true
```
Preview enabled. Portal at https://preview.acme.example.com — shared with customer.

linda_am: I'll update the agenda and send a short pre-call note. sara, want me on the call to cover billing/renewal Qs?

sara_cs: Please join. I'll open the bridge at 14:55. mike — post here once autoscaler recovers so we can move them from preview to full provisioning.

mike_eng: Autoscaler remediation complete and pool capacity increased. Observed healthy responses, provisioning success rate back to baseline. Recovery took ~35m.

jon_support: Verified — onboarding flow succeeded for acme-22. Customer ran their test scenario and confirmed preview satisfied demo needs; will follow up for full provisioning after internal approvals. Support ticket #CS-123456 marked resolved.

sara_cs: Fantastic work — thanks everyone. I'll send the post-call summary + renewal touch plan and add an enablement doc for their next steps. :tada:   

oncall-bot: incident closed — duration 35m — owners: mike_eng, jon_support
